mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: The Fast Lift
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. A lift that runs twice as fast.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: Altar
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: Switch
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: The Wide Lift
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. A big lift for a full party.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Elevator of the Abyss: Anchored
mechanics.desc: A platform on old rails that carries delvers up and down a shaft in the rock, in no hurry and in no mood to wait: step on while it passes, and step off while it pauses. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: The lift runs when it wants. It always has.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: The Spiralling Updraft
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. The air spirals as it rises: a gentle spin round the column.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: Leap
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: Switch
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: The Hurricane Lift
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. A hurricane instead of a breeze: it throws you.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The Sky Dragon's Updraft: Synchrony
mechanics.desc: A column of rising air in the middle of the hall that lifts whoever steps into it to the gallery above, and sets them down again when the gust tires. Light every pillar within a few seconds of each other.
mechanics.flavor: The wind is a friend who loves a good fall.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: The Stone Door
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. A stone slab drops across the door in place of bars.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: Omen
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. It strikes once, the moment the area is first entered.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: Anchored
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: The Slow Door
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. The door closes slowly, giving a quick party time to slip out.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The One-Way Door: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: The door swings shut behind the party and does not swing back: the way ahead is the only way out, and a lever somewhere in the room lets the door open again. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: There is no turning back. That is the point.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: The Next Gate
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. The gate leads to the next hall in a fixed order.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: Toll
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. Pay the price in items at the altar.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: The Home Gate
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. The gate always leads back to the first hall.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: Greed
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Gate Network: Soul-tithe
mechanics.desc: A pad on a pedestal that sends the party to another hall of the floor: a network of gates that nobody mapped, each one a little different from the last. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: A teleportation gate is just a door that doesn't care where it opens.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: The Pressing Shaft
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. A heavier air at the bottom: more of a push down.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: Leap
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: The Dark Shaft
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. The shaft is pitch dark.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: Hush
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. Crouching in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Vertical Shaft: Switch
mechanics.desc: A shaft drops into the dark; at its mouth an updraft that holds a body in the air and slowly lets it down: the descent is long, the fall is gentle, and the ascent is a different matter. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Up is the hard direction.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor: The Reverse Belt
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. The belt runs the other way.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor: Switch
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor: The Fast Belt
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. A faster belt.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Steam Conveyor: Clockwork
mechanics.desc: A hall of belts driven by an old boiler that carries everything on it along at a steady pace: stand still and be taken, run against it and go nowhere. It runs on a timer for as long as anyone stays.
mechanics.flavor: Steam is just patience under pressure.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake: Thin Ice
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. The ice is thin: a pit opens where weight settles.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake: Switch
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake: Deep Snow
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. Powder snow, not ice: a heavy wading.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Frozen Lake: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A hall whose floor is one sheet of ice: slow sliding, no purchase, and a long way to the other side. The ice is old and the cold remembers. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: The ice has been there longer than the name of the lake.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads: Honey Pads
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. Sticky honey pads that slow instead of bounce.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads: Threshold
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads: Anchored
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. Hold a marked plate for a few seconds to still it.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads: The Long Jump
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. A bounce that carries a great way sideways.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Slime Bounce Pads: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: Pads of resilient jelly in the floor that throw a jumper up and away: the trick is to land on the right one. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Slimes are very good at being bounced on.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp: The Home Spiral
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. The spiral always returns the party to where it entered.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp: Altar
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp: Switch
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp: The Swap Spiral
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. The spiral swaps two delvers.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Spiral Warp: Gaze
mechanics.desc: A spiral in the air that swallows whoever walks into it and spits them out at some other part of the room: the warp is a little different each time, and it has never sent anybody anywhere dull. It wakes when someone looks straight at it.
mechanics.flavor: A space-time jutsu: the world twisted into a point.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light: The Bridge of Shadow
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. A bridge of shadow: black glass that fades faster.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light: Lantern-bearer
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. Carry a light through it long enough and it relents.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light: The Steadfast Bridge
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. A lasting bridge: the planks stay a good while.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Bridge of Light: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A chasm with no bridge, crossed by those with the light to make one: every step lays a plank of pale light that fades a moment after the foot has left it. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: A bridge between realms is only as good as the person who walks it.

mechanics.name: The Underground River
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Underground River: The Rapids
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold. Rapids rather than a calm flow: faster and rougher.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Underground River: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Underground River: Switch
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Underground River: The Cold River
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold. A river of snowmelt.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Underground River: Footfall
mechanics.desc: A black river runs through the cavern and carries things away: wade in and be carried a long way down the course, feet off the floor and nothing to hold. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Flowing water, flowing dark, flowing rumour.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle: The Backward Circle
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin. The circle leads to the previous hall.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle: Altar
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle: The Quick Circle
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin. The circle fires at once, without the pause.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Teleportation Circle: Stillness
mechanics.desc: A ring of runes in the floor, inlaid with silver, linked to another ring somewhere in the dungeon: stand in it with the right words and it sends you to its twin. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: It's a fine system, until someone forgets the password.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs: The Floating Steps
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. Floating steps, a few at a time.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs: Threshold
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs: Switch
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs: The False Stairs
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. Some of the steps are not there: pits where the stair was.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Shifting Stairs: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Stairs that rearrange themselves as they are climbed: some flights are real, some lead nowhere, and the real ones change when the party's back is turned. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: The stairs are never where you left them.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet: The Cross Carpet
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. The carpet flies across the room the other way.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet: Switch
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet: The Carpet in a Storm
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. A gale tugs at the carpet and knocks the riders about.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Flying Carpet: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A woven platform that glides across a chasm on a slow, magical wind: a seat for as many as the weaver could fit and no handrail. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Up, up, and not too steeply.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate to a Far Hall
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. The gate opens onto another hall.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick: Soul-tithe
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. Pay a few levels of experience at the altar to end it.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick: The Gate Back
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. The gate opens back where the party came in.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Gate of Nazarick: Greed
mechanics.desc: A dark gate with a gold rim that opens to whichever place its master chooses: the party can ask it, but it only sends them somewhere it has already decided upon. It reacts to the use of items in its area.
mechanics.flavor: Gate.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands: The Heavy Islands
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. Heavy gravity instead of light: the jumps are shorter and the falls harder.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands: Switch
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands: The Drifting Islands
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. The islands drift as well.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Floating Islands: Leap
mechanics.desc: A hall of islands of stone hanging in the air: gravity is light, the gaps are wide, and the way across is a chain of jumps that are never quite where they seem. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Aincrad has many floors, and none of them stay put.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute: The Chute to the Next Hall
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. The chute runs to the next hall.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute: Footfall
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute: Creeping
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Sneak through its area long enough and it loses interest.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute: The Rough Chute
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. A rough ride: a bump on arrival.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Trapdoor Chute: Leap
mechanics.desc: An unremarkable stretch of floor that tips open under the weight of a heavy foot and slides everyone down a chute into another part of the dungeon. Jumping in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Trapdoor. Roll a Reflex save. Or don't.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails: The Black Bulls' Wagon
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. The wagon is slower and rougher.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails: Threshold
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. It strikes every time someone steps back into the area.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails: Switch
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails: A Crossing Pair
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. Two carriages cross at the middle.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Airship Rails: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: A set of rails of pale light that a carriage of the Magic Knights runs on, back and forth across the hall at a stately pace. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: The Golden Dawn's carriage never loses time.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts: The Long Swing
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. A swing that carries across the whole hall.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts: Tripwire
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. It springs when someone comes within a few blocks of its heart.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts: Switch
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. A lever somewhere in the area switches it off.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts: The Snapping Cable
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. The cable snaps: a hard fall at the end.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Anchor Posts: Footfall
mechanics.desc: Iron posts set into the walls and ceiling, made for swinging: a jump near one hooks it and swings the delver the length of the hall at speed. Running in its area sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: Gear up. Swing. Don't think about the ground.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze: The Swapping Doors
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. The doors swap two delvers.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze: Altar
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. It needs a hand on its altar block to begin.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze: Sequenced
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. Use its pedestals in the right order to end it.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze: The Doorless Maze
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. No door leads away: the party is tossed around the same room.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.

mechanics.name: The Portal Maze: Stillness
mechanics.desc: A hall of doorways to places that may or may not exist, each with a keyhole and a rumour: step through the right one and it is a shortcut, the wrong one and it is somewhere else. Standing still in its area for a few seconds sets it off.
mechanics.flavor: There's a door to everywhere, if you know the key.
